composition_variation: An original beautiful 26-year-old adult anime woman with a mint-green tousled bob, dark turquoise tips, vivid violet eyes, arched brows and a beaming self-confident adult face. She crouches compactly on a bright city park path to tie a sneaker, one foot planted forward and the opposite knee tucked close, naturally balanced. Both hands meet at the forward shoe laces with carefully articulated fingers; she lifts her head to smile toward the viewer. Her torso leans naturally forward. Camera is above eye level, emphasizing her face, arms and triangular body silhouette. Complete compact figure with knees, sneakers, hands and face clearly separated. Outfit: opaque white short-sleeved loose athletic T-shirt, dark emerald normal mid-thigh sports shorts, white-lime sneakers; clothing stays securely covering. Saturated bubblegum-pink pavement, two neon-yellow diagonal court stripes at the bottom, deep cobalt foliage silhouettes at outer edges. Upper quarter is a vivid magenta-to-purple field. Mint hair highlights, delicate pink cheek reflection and decisive emerald/ultramarine shadows. Large precise face with brilliant irises, crisp eyelashes and attractive adult proportions. Energetic nonsexual sports-fashion mood with explosive color-block design.
